newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends at lows on CBOT, commercials/funds.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends at lows on CBOT, commercials/funds.

text.p: WCE canola futures closed lower and at session lows, pressured by mostly lower CBOT soycomplex futures, commercial and fund selling, traders said.

"There was good commercial selling all day. Funds sold 500 early and hedges picked up," a trader said. Nov-Jan spread at $3.90, Nov-Mar $5, Jan-Mar $1. Volume was 6,735 lots, or 134,700 tonnes, with 875 hedge lots.
Japan bought 3,000 tonnes overnight, sources said.
November canola fell $4.70 to $435 and January dipped $3.70 to $439.30. October flax rose $0.50 to $395, November down $0.50 to $369.50 on commercial selling. Volume was 250, 40 hedges, sources said.

October feed wheat lost $2.50 to $206.80 and December was down $3 at $192.50 on commission and local selling and Alberta Wheat Pool selling the Oct-Mar spread at $16, traders said. Dec-Mar spread at $2.50, Oct-Dec $13. Volume was 2,000 lots.
November western barley lost $3 to $150.80, February slipped $3 to $154.80 with XCan and Benson Quinn selling, floor sources said. Nov-Feb at $4. Volume was 900 lots.
Cargill sold October oats down US$5 to US$132 and UGG bought peas up US$0.70 to US$1.50 at US$211 to US$212.80, traders said.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
